representative_day_rule: Median 07:00-09:00 upstream station 402370 mean flow among the five predeclared calibration weekdays.
selection_reason: Calibration only: final bounded candidate uses the existing 1007.33 m upstream network buffer, 80% coverage station 400790 inlet proxy, and a 1500 veh/h downstream net-exit hypothesis. Representative-day full-lane station flow MAPE 8.38% and speed MAE 5.93 mph, clean and cleared. This improves speed versus the no-buffer candidate (11.91 mph) and flow versus the buffer without net exit (10.90%). Confirm all five calibration days before freezing validation; no further candidate fitting. Final five-day/three-seed calibration: 8.32% flow MAPE, 8.15 mph speed MAE, 15/15 clean and cleared. SUMO indices 1–4 retained at 402377 after the calibration-only alternative gave 23.05% flow MAPE / 4.07 mph speed MAE versus 8.61% / 3.01 mph.
